==Description==
The '''Snowman''' was an enemy that only appeared in [[Village of Despair]] as part of the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. It was slightly faster and had more health than the [[Frozen (Village of Despair)|Frozen]]. It also could not be frozen by the [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]].

==Appearance==
The '''Snowman''' had white sand skin to represent snow. The '''Snowman''' also wore a top hat on its head and had a carrot nose. There were three black buttons on its torso, and its mouth and eyes were also made out of buttons.

==Strategy==
*The '''Snowman''' is completely immune to the [[Freezer]] and [[Frost Blaster]], including the [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Age''.
**This leaves the [[Pyromancer]] as a viable option to slow it down.
*As the '''Snowman''' normally spawns in hordes, the [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]] and [[Archer|Holiday Archer]] are quite effective against it.
*A simple [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger|Outlaw]] should be able to take care of these.
**However, as they debut early on during the game, you will have to save for these towers.
